get_results_ui_url: generate the URL to visualize results for a given system ID and API host
review_get_results_ui_url: review the get_results_ui_url function that maps API hosts to UI visualization URLs
refactor_API_TO_UI_HOSTS: refactor the _API_TO_UI_HOSTS mapping to add or remove known API to UI host pairs
test_get_results_ui_url: test the get_results_ui_url function with known and unknown API host inputs
summarize_ui_module: summarize the ui module that provides URL generation for OCP API result visualization
